name: editioncurriculumbinding
sql:
CREATE TABLE editioncurriculumbinding (
	curriculum_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	edition_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	scope_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	scope_sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	scope_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	graph_sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_by VARCHAR, 
	reviewed_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (curriculum_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_edition_scope_draft UNIQUE (edition_key, scope_sha256), 
	FOREIGN KEY(curriculum_id) REFERENCES curriculum (id)
)

name: topicplacement
sql:
CREATE TABLE topicplacement (
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	curriculum_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	edition_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	subject_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	level INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	order_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (topic_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_subject_topic_order UNIQUE (curriculum_id, subject_key, order_index), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(curriculum_id) REFERENCES editioncurriculumbinding (curriculum_id)
)
